name: isSmsAuthenticationDisabled
definition: True when every enforced, MFA-requiring JumpCloud authentication policy has an explicit mfaFactors list and none of them lists SMS_OTP. False when an enforced MFA-requiring policy lists SMS_OTP. A policy using "All Enabled" factors cannot show whether SMS is allowed and is not measured.
population: enforced (not disabled, not monitor-only, action allow) authentication policies that require MFA
evidenceRequiredForTrue: every enforced MFA-requiring policy has an explicit factor list and none lists SMS_OTP

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the registry gate can fail push runs on main; proposed, single emitter. No enforced MFA-requiring policy is not measured, by the file's own rule.
